OutstandingTask.description:
A task this run served and has not settled, as it was served.

Never from `assessment_tasks`. A pack is mutable and a run is not, so re-reading the
bank would let an edit made after the serving decide what the learner is held to have
been asked.
OutstandingTask.title: OutstandingTask

PlayReport.description: One play of a task's recording, recorded before it was heard.
PlayReport.title: PlayReport

PresentationChoice.description: One button. `value` is submitted and scored; `display` is only drawn.
PresentationChoice.title: PresentationChoice

RunListReport.description: The runs a fresh page could resume, newest first, for one track.
RunListReport.title: RunListReport

RunScreen.description: The whole state of one run, in one read.
RunScreen.title: RunScreen

ServedAsset.description:
A recording as served: which one was meant, and which bytes were played.

Both halves, always. The content ID answers *which recording was meant*; only the
digest answers *is this the recording they heard*, which is the one question the
snapshot exists to settle.
ServedAsset.title: ServedAsset

TaskAudio.description:
The recording a listening task plays, and how often it may be played.

The allowance sits *inside* this record rather than beside it, so "a replay
allowance where nothing is played" is unrepresentable instead of being a rule
somebody has to write and somebody else has to check.
TaskAudio.title: TaskAudio

TaskPresentation.description:
How one task is rendered. Absent means *free text*, which is not the same thing
as `kind: free-text` with nothing else: an absent record is a pack that has not been
authored for the client, and an explicit one is a decision somebody made.
TaskPresentation.title: TaskPresentation

launchToken.description: Minted per server start, handed to the page through the URL fragment, and never written to disk.
launchToken.name: X-LinguaWiki-Token

info.description: Generated from the Pydantic contracts and the server's own route table; never edited by hand. This document describes **shapes, not sequences**. At most one outstanding task per dimension, idempotent serving, scoring against the serve-time snapshot rather than the live pack, and every consent rule live in the service layer and its tests. Conformance to this document is not correctness.\n\nEvery request carries the launch token this server minted when it started; a launchToken is valid for one server start and is never stored.
info.summary: A loopback transport over the LinguaWiki service layer.
info.title: LinguaWiki learner client
